title: The Telangana Famine Relief Fund Act, 1936.
full_text: The Telangana Famine Relief Fund Act, 1936. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 193616 Act Number: 16 Enactment Date: 1936-10-08 Act Year: 1936 Short Title: The Telangana Famine Relief Fund Act, 1936. Long Title: An Act to provide for the establishment and maintenance in the State of Telangana of a Fund, called the Telangana Famine Relief Fund, for utilization on occasions of serious famine and of distress caused by serious drought, flood or other natural calamities in the said State.
